'''Taget''' was a [[Nomai]] who grew up on [[Ember Twin]].

==Early life==
In the [[Sunless City]], Taget played the [[Anglerfish]] game along with [[Lami]], [[Laevi]], [[Ilex]], and [[Solanum]]. Initially, he could not find the entrance to the Anglerfish fossil, but Lami pointed out that he could no longer fit through the Anglerfish Overlook hole anymore since he grew taller than Laevi.<ref name=tall>TAGET: I tried to get to the fossil fish through the Stepping Stone Cave, but I couldn’t find the entrance. Where is it? LAMI: Taget can’t fit through the Anglerfish Overlook hole anymore because he grew bigger! He’s taller than Laevi now.</ref> 

==Statue Workshop==
During the [[Ash Twin Project]]'s construction, Taget moved to the [[Statue Workshop]] on [[Giant's Deep]] with Laevi and Lami, where [[Phlox]] was crafting the [[Nomai Statue|memory statues]]. At some point, Lami suggested that they should sneak into the workshop during a test of the memory statues, but Taget pointed out that Phlox had specifically told them not to do that.<ref>LAMI: They’re going to test the memory statues tonight! Phlox says it could be dangerous, so we can’t come. LAMI: But, what if we didn’t use the door and snuck in the other way? Does anyone want to? TAGET: Phlox specifically told us not to do that.</ref>

Taget passed away after the [[Ghost Matter]] from the [[Interloper]] blanketed the [[solar system]], which killed all Nomai.

==Trivia==
* ''[[Wikipedia:Tagetes|Tagetes]]'' is a genus of plants in the sunflower family, commonly known as marigolds.
